purpose: First direct analytical falsification test of the fixed geometric SWAP-MODFLOW interface with interface hydraulic head deliberately different from SWAP phreatic elevation.

geometry.top_system: lumped phreatic storage above z_c connected hydraulically to the fixed interface plane
geometry.groundwater_system: MODFLOW-like storage below the interface plane
geometry.physical_ownership: top and groundwater inventories are disjoint; interface transfer is internal and must cancel

states.H_c: hydraulic head at fixed coupling plane z_c and the MODFLOW-side unknown
states.semantic_requirement: H_c and z_p are not aliases

sign_convention.E_c: positive from top/SWAP control volume into groundwater/MODFLOW control volume
sign_convention.W_S: positive external volume into top/SWAP control volume
sign_convention.W_M: positive external volume into groundwater/MODFLOW control volume

closed_form.note: Targets are the exact decimal solution of the stated linear equations: dz_p=0.06 m, dH_c=0.04 m, E_c=0.004 m.

critical_semantic_observation: The imposed vertical conductance belongs inside the SWAP/top-system surrogate between its phreatic state and the fixed coupling plane. It is not a q-link resistance between a SWAP interface head and a MODFLOW interface head: those interface heads remain one and the same H_c.

hypotheses.H1: A physically consistent solution exists with H_c != z_p while head continuity at the geometric interface is exact.
hypotheses.H2: Interface transfer enters the two component ledgers with equal magnitude and opposite sign.
hypotheses.H3: The complete-system balance is independent of the internal interface transfer.
hypotheses.H4: For C_v -> infinity, z_p-H_c -> 0 while total storage remains S_S+S_M; this is a hydrostatic limit, not a change in state semantics.
hypotheses.H5: For finite C_v, replacing H_c by z_p as the MODFLOW coupling state changes the equations and must not reproduce the preregistered nonhydrostatic oracle except accidentally.

falsification: The independently solved equations cannot produce a finite H_c and z_p with the stated balances.
The implementation requires separate SWAP-side and MODFLOW-side interface heads to close the declared zero-thickness interface.
The component interface transfers fail equal-and-opposite cancellation.
The complete mass error exceeds 1e-12 m in the analytic implementation.
A numerical implementation converges to values inconsistent with the preregistered closed-form equations.
numerical_nonclaims: This preregistration does not qualify u/q_u.
This preregistration does not qualify HCOF/RHS.
This preregistration does not select an IMS tolerance or acceleration policy.
This preregistration is not a finite-resistance two-model q-link test.
next_after_oracle: Implement an independent small analytic solver/test, verify the preregistered equations, then derive the eliminated groundwater residual and only then compare its tangent/intercept with production response condensation.
